rows.ARS:
Medium yellow Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: JACjel
Exhibition name: Sunbright ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by William A. Warriner (United States, before 1977).
Introduced in United States by Jackson & Perkins Co. (post 1970) as 'Sunbright'.
rows.Bloom: Yellow. Chrome yellow, occasional vegetative green midrib atea on outer petals. Petals round.. None to mild fragrance. 25 to 35 petals. Average diameter 4.75". Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit: Armed with thorns / prickles, well-branched. Reddish-purple foliage.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b and warmer. Disease susceptibility: susceptible to blackspot . Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
